rows.surface: Per-app exact registered process selection and stop verification
rows.mechanism: Immutable registered descriptors control exact LS bundle/executable/plugin selection, with infrastructure exclusions. Stop captures PID/birth/path, validates a RunningBoard handle audit token against the kernel executable, rechecks birth/path and submits an identity+PID handle predicate. Failed evidence or service denial has no direct PID/name signal fallback. The prior held-task termination was disproved on iOS 16.7.16 (task_terminate rejects BSD-backed tasks). The replacement is not a proof of atomic PID-version-bound final system dispatch; independent exit/socket observation and a launch fence remain necessary. Launch/observer admission retains process birth and executable under its lease.
